title: chore: ignore jetbrains ide files
author: intellild
summary: Adds `.idea` to .gitignore. One line that can't affect builds or output. The only question is a preference: kdy1 asked whether editor ignores belong in a personal global gitignore instead.
evidence: Diff is just `+.idea` at the end of .gitignore. kdy1 (member) 2026-11-03: "Not sure if this ignore should be per-project". No maintainer comment. If the maintainer prefers a global gitignore for editor files, close it with a one-line note instead.
